regenerate_license: regenerate the top-level LICENSE file by concatenating individual model LICENSE files
check_license: check if the top-level LICENSE file is up to date without modifying it
get_base_license: extract the base project license from opensource/LICENSE or the existing concatenated LICENSE
generate_license: generate concatenated LICENSE content from individual model LICENSE directories
run_license_check: run the regenerate_license.py script with --check to verify LICENSE file freshness
